summary: This is a routine earnings release on Form 6-K for Betterware de Mexico's first quarter 2026 results. The filing reports modest revenue growth of 0.3% year-over-year, a 13.9% increase in EBITDA, and a 27.0% ROIC. It mentions the pending acquisition of Tupperware's Latin America operations and expects regulatory approvals in Q2 2026, but the filing itself is not a special-situation event. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or deal mechanics are provided beyond the update. There is no special-situation category triggered; this is a standard reporting update.
